Which key is that?

This page shows which key you press on your Logitech Harmony remote, while the remote is connected to this computer with its USB cable. It shows each key as the number the remote itself uses for it.

What it does, and what it does not

  • It only reads. It asks the remote two things: its version, which says which model it is, and two bytes of its working memory, where the remote keeps the key being held and the last key pressed. It never writes to the remote and never changes its setup.
  • Nothing leaves your browser. There is no server behind this page and nothing is sent anywhere. The page reads your remote and shows what it read, and that is all.
  • It works with the Harmony 880, 885, 880 Pro and 720, in Chrome or Edge on a computer. Other remotes are not offered in the list, and a remote that is not running normally, such as one held in its recovery mode, is let go without its keys being read.

Plug your remote in, then press Connect.
